column1: # A/B variants for scripts/bench.sh sweep.  TAB-separated, three fields:
#   name <TAB> amcl.yaml overrides <TAB> extra race.launch.py arguments
# Overrides are comma-separated key=value pairs applied to the SHIPPED
# config/amcl.yaml, so a variant is a one-line diff against what actually races
# and can never drift from it. Leave the field as `-` for no override.
# There is deliberately NO dead-reckoning-only variant. Every run already
# carries a `dr_err` column -- dead reckoning measured on the SAME trajectory at
# the SAME instants -- so the comparison is paired and free. A separate run
# would be a worse experiment, not a better one.
